title: Determinant lower bound for a symmetric matrix with a coercive quadratic form (spectral theorem)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let S = (S_ij)_{i,j ∈ Fin N} be a real N×N matrix and let c ∈ ℝ with c ≥ 0. Assume S is symmetric (S_ij = S_ji for all i, j) and c·Σ_i ξ_i² ≤ Σ_i Σ_j ξ_i S_ij ξ_j for every ξ ∈ ℝ^{Fin N}. Then c^N ≤ det S.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → (∀ i j, S i j = S j i) → (∀ ξ : Fin N → ℝ, c * ∑ i, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ξ i * S i j * ξ j) → c ^ N ≤ S.det
